name: m4-gameplay-branches
description: The declared required gameplay branches for the M4 acceptance term GAMEPLAY_RELIABILITY ('every declared required gameplay branch runs without an unexpected runtime failure', docs/STATUS.md). scripts/m4_check.py derives each branch's state only from checks it actually ran in the same invocation: a branch with no covering check is UNCOVERED, and GAMEPLAY_RELIABILITY is never PASS while any required branch is UNCOVERED, any covering check did not run or failed, or any blocking inventory item is open. A covering check proves only what its scenario exercises, under one fixed clock and seed.
list_status: PROVISIONAL (conservative reading, 2026-11-25): the six categories are the ones epic #163 names (combat, death and recovery, timers, objects, scoring, save/load); the branches inside each are this file's reading of PLAN M4 'Build' and of the failure inventory's unexercised areas. The maintainer has not yet approved a final required-branch list. Adding a branch can only turn the term away from PASS.
checks_namespace: Each entry in `checks` is a make target listed in tests/scenarios/m4-manifest.json (scenarios, persistence or playable_subchecks). Discovery runs that are not gated checks (tests/scenarios/failure-inventory-cases.json) are cited in `evidence_only` and never count as coverage.

branches.description: the thief (ROBBER) fights, steals and is fought
branches.note: covered under the fixed clock and seed by two gated scenarios together, neither alone. Steals: test-m4-thief-robbery (observed, not chased) shows the ROBBER demon's thief taking the painting from the hero in the Gallery (and, at prefix 12's end of input, from the room), passing again without finding anything, and keeping it in his bag (HOBJS); there he is never in a room with the hero. Fights and is fought: test-m4-thief-fight enters his Treasure Room (strange-passage's way past the cyclops, `up`): TREASURE-ROOM (77act1.mud:623) brings him there whatever the seed, with FIGHTBIT set, and the FIGHTING demon has him attack at once (a miss); `kill thief with sword` twice: the hero wounds him twice (OCAPAC 4 -> 3 -> 2), he wounds the hero, then knocks him out and kills him (JIGS-UP, patched with `y`). Not exercised: the thief appearing by chance in another room (the ROBBER demon's PROB 30 "Someone carrying a large bag is casually leaning against one of the walls here") or leaving a fight ("Your opponent, determining discretion ..."), the hero killing or knocking out the thief (his booty and the treasures reappearing, ROBBER-FUNCTION's DEAD!, OUT! and IN!), the stiletto knocked from his hand, giving or throwing him objects, the chalice taken, and the thief stealing from the hero's room while present ("The other occupant just left ...")

branches.description: CEVENT clock interrupts beyond the troll and cure clocks (CLOCK-INT 77rooms.mud:1657)
branches.note: covered under the fixed clock and seed by two clock events: the match clock MATIN (match-clock: MATCH-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:1925 queues it with CTICK 2 at each `light match`; it fires at the next tick under a regular command and under a `wait`, which stops there; `turn off match` sets it to 0) and the dam's leak clock MNTIN (maint-leak: MAINT-ROOM 77act1.mud:737 queues it with CTICK -1 at `push blue button`, so it fires on every CLOCK-DEMON pass and raises the Maintenance Room's water level, five passes during one `wait`; LEAK-FUNCTION's putty sets it to 0; reachable since INV-11 was fixed, #193). The CLOCKER's whole event list is checkpointed every turn. The candle clock CNDIN is queued and fired too (coal-machine and gas-room: CANDLES queues it at `take candles`; its first 50-tick interval ends in coal-machine at entry 90) and checkpointed by the puzzles profile, as evidence beyond the two cited checks; the balloon clocks BINT and BRNIN are queued, fired and checkpointed in balloon-ledge (gated since #196), as evidence beyond the two cited checks. Not reached by any gated check: the fuse (FUSIN), ledge (LEDIN), safe (SAFIN), gnome (VLGIN, GNOIN), bucket (BCKIN) and sphere (SPHIN) clocks

branches.description: take, drop, open containers, take from and put into containers
take all, drop all, put all in (EVERYTHING)
turning the lamp on; darkness without light
the dam, the boat and the river, the balloon, the coal-mine machine and basket, the gas room
branches.note: COVERED (all five listed puzzles are exercised by gated checks since #196 promoted balloon-ledge; INV-12 resolved), under the fixed clock and seed, each on one route. The dam (dam-sluice; reachable since INV-11 was fixed, #193): the wrench, the bolt refused without GATE-FLAG, the yellow button, the bolt turned (BOLT-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:701: the sluice gates open, LOW-TIDE), the trunk taken from the drained reservoir, across the reservoir bed. The boat (boat-river): the pump fetched from Reservoir North, the folded boat inflated with it at the Dam Base (IBOAT-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:285), boarded, launched onto the River Frigid (RIVR1 only), landed, left, deflated and taken. The balloon (balloon-ledge, gated since #196): the receptacle opened, the guidebook put in, the basket boarded (BALLOON's READ-OUT call with PRSVEC slot 2 #FALSE (); its attached #DECL is not enforced since #196, as natively), the guidebook burned (BALLOON 77act2.mud:419: BINF, BINT and BRNIN queued), the balloon risen to VAIR1 and VAIR2 and landed on the Narrow Ledge, the wire tied to the hook (WIRE-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:585: BTIE, BINT disabled) and untied, the balloon off the ledge again, descending after `close receptacle` and landed at the Volcano Bottom. The coal-mine machine and basket (coal-machine): the coal carried up from the Dead End, put in the basket with the screwdriver and the burning candles and lowered (DUMBWAITER 77act2.mud:74, CAGE-TOP false), the empty-handed passage from the Timber Room (NO-OBJS, EMPTY-HANDED) to the Lower Shaft lit by the candles (LIGHT-SHAFT scored), the machine's lid, the switch turned with the screwdriver (MSWITCH-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:139: the coal becomes the diamond), the diamond put in the basket and raised (CAGE-TOP T). The gas room (gas-room): BOOM-ROOM (77act2.mud:3) on walking in with the lamp only (nothing happens; the bracelet taken) and with the burning candles (the coal-gas explosion, JIGS-UP, patched). Out of scope, not exercised by any gated check: the river downstream (RIVR2 on, the falls, the buoy), the reservoir refilling, the gas room's ON branch (a flame lit inside), the balloon's other destinations (VAIR3, VAIR4, the upper ledge and the Volcano View), the balloon crashing or the fire going out in the air (BRNIN expiring), the volcano gnome, and a switch command without an indirect object (MSWITCH-FUNCTION's IMP: the #196 sweep's probe only)
